title: Conditional dual-frame information hierarchy
statement: Use the exact monotone conditional-regression hierarchy and its Pythagorean information gains to obtain a dimension-uniform half-window RPCD certificate.

signature.core_candidate_lemma: A carefully chosen intermediate sigma-field captures a universal fraction of the exact inverse moment while retaining full random-rank averaging.
